props.text: Next free run + the colliding open release(s):
I understand this reuses an open renban

config.script:
log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE.renban.ui")
	p = self.view.params
	import renban
	import auth as A
	if p.nextFree is None:
		self.view.custom.warn = "No free run available — close a stale release first, then cancel."; return
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)   # SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (BLOCKER-2)
		siteId = self.session.custom.siteId if hasattr(self.session.custom, "siteId") else None
		res = renban.commit_renban_breakdown(p.group, int(p.trailers), int(p.pallets), "Inventory_Spike",
			resolution={"action": "use_next_free", "base": int(p.nextFree), "alarm_id": p.alarmId},
			siteId=siteId, session=self.session)
		self.view.custom.result = res["status"]
		if res["status"] == "COLLISION":
			self.view.custom.warn = "Lost race: the suggested run was taken. Re-run the breakdown."; return
		log.info("SPIKE renban use_next_free committed base=%s" % p.nextFree)
		system.perspective.closePopup("renbanCollision")
	except A.AuthError, ae:
		self.view.custom.warn = "DENIED (server-side): %s" % ae
		log.warn("SPIKE renban use_next_free DENIED (server-side gate): %s" % ae)
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.warn = "Use-next-free failed: %s" % e

# PROCEED ANYWAY: requires the confirm checkbox (a second confirm — they may know the old release
	# is closing). Acknowledged set = the renbans the operator SAW colliding (params.acknowledged), so
	# the in-tx re-check still aborts on a DIFFERENT number taken newly since the WARN.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE.renban.ui")
	c = self.view.custom; p = self.view.params
	if not c.confirmOverride:
		c.warn = "Tick 'I understand this reuses an open renban' to proceed anyway."; return
	import renban
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)   # SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (BLOCKER-2)
		siteId = self.session.custom.siteId if hasattr(self.session.custom, "siteId") else None
		res = renban.commit_renban_breakdown(p.group, int(p.trailers), int(p.pallets), "Inventory_Spike",
			resolution={"action": "override", "alarm_id": p.alarmId, "acknowledged": list(p.acknowledged or [])},
			siteId=siteId, actor="operator", session=self.session)
		c.result = res["status"]
		if res["status"] == "COLLISION":
			c.warn = "Lost race: a NEW number was taken since the warning. Re-run the breakdown."; return
		log.info("SPIKE renban override committed group=%s" % p.group)
		system.perspective.closePopup("renbanCollision")
	except A.AuthError, ae:
		c.warn = "DENIED (server-side): %s" % ae
		log.warn("SPIKE renban override DENIED (server-side gate): %s" % ae)
	except Exception, e:
		c.warn = "Override failed: %s" % e

# CANCEL is purely client-side: NO driver call. The RENBAN_COLLISION alarm STAYS active
	# (BIT_RESOLVED=0) on the home hub as a standing reminder to go close the stale release.
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE.renban.ui").info("SPIKE renban collision CANCELLED (alarm left active)")
	system.perspective.closePopup("renbanCollision")
